Uplink IT Academy

Exam practice, a help desk simulator and command-line labs for people moving from help desk to network engineering.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Most candidates prepare for certifications with question banks and slides. They pass, then stall on their first real ticket because they have never diagnosed a fault with real tools.

02

What it does

Sets of 200 original scenario questions per exam, each with a full explanation. A ticket simulator for a fictional company, Harborline Logistics, with a queue, directory, server room, remote desktop and mail console. Labs for Windows, Linux, security and Cisco IOS that check each objective as you type. Also a troubleshooting coach, short courses, a career agent that reads a resume, and Network Docs, where businesses order documentation of their network.

03

How it is built

Each lab is defined as data: a device, a scripted shell and a list of checks. Before a lab is published, a grader replays the reference solution through the same engine the learner uses. A scheduled job adds one lab per track every day and publishes only the labs that pass.
